primitives.name: Approval Gating Function

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: t: Time step (discrete), A_t: Approval flag (binary), C_t: Code mutation attempt (boolean)
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a strictly sequential temporal ordering where documentation precedes code execution.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if the approval latency approaches infinity, stalling the entire development pipeline.
